# Design Review Skill

## Must Follow
- Prompt: `.github/prompts/design-review.prompt.md`
- Shared instructions: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Documentation: `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md`

## Tasks
1. Review requirements and architecture.
2. Verify architecture covers all acceptance criteria.
3. Identify missing requirements, risks and design issues.
4. Create or update `docs/design-review.md`.
5. Create or update `docs/agent-reports/design-review-agent-report.md`.

## Mandatory Agent Report
Include findings, recommendations, files changed, approval status and handover status.

## Rules
- Always update both documents.
- Do not write application code.
- Do not expand approved scope.
- Complete only after both documents are updated.
